text: The cited survey states that RLHF, though the central method used to finetune state-of-the-art LLMs, has flaws that relatively little public work has systematized; it catalogues these flaws, emphasizes the limitations of RLHF and the importance of a multi-faceted approach to safer AI systems, and proposes auditing and disclosure standards.
